# AI Fund Observation

Purpose

This repository documents an AI-assisted investment observation project.

The goal is not to determine which AI performs best.
The goal is to observe how each AI makes decisions and how its own reasoning evolves over time.

This repository is intended to help both humans and AI assistants understand the project structure.

Start here

1. README.md
2. investing/handover.md
3. investing/rules.md

Additional documents

- observer/workflow.md
- observer/history.md

Per-AI context

Each participating AI has its own history file.

- investing/funds/chatgpt.md
- investing/funds/claude.md
- investing/funds/gemini.md
- investing/funds/grok.md

Each AI should review its own history file before making new investment decisions.
If its investment reasoning has changed over time, explain what changed and why.

Private data

Current holdings and monthly reports are stored in a private repository.

These files are intentionally excluded from the public repository and are provided by the project owner when required.

Authority

investing/rules.md is the authoritative source for project rules.

handover.md is a simplified entry point.
